name: MoYu WeiLong AI 3x3 V11 Guided Recovery Edition (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core) - Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The MoYu WeiLong 3x3 V11 AI Guided Edition brings smart lighting to the flagship WeiLong line — an 8-light ball-core that flashes step-by-step solving guidance right on the cube, wrapped in a transparent six-color body that shows every mechanism as it turns.
features: Beginner-friendly: Converts solving formulas into light guidance, so new cubers can work toward a solve without learning notation first.
Show-stopping look: The transparent six-color body glows with flowing light as you turn — every solve puts on a display.
MagLev feel: Springs are replaced by repelling magnets for low-friction, quiet turning with a crisp rebound.
Ball-core stability: The 8-light ball-core stabilizes rotation direction and reduces deviation while it drives the lighting guidance.
Crystal magnet chamber: Visible magnets sit embedded in the transparent pieces like stars, adding texture to the flowing crystal aesthetic.
Built to last: Integrated anti-drop structure, anti-pop corner design, dragon-scale anti-stick texture, and lube-groove design for smoother turning.
